verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent tracing and observability product, so capturing multimodal payloads in traces is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence documents span capture over OpenTelemetry, manual track_ai events and span tagging, but nothing about capturing images, audio or file attachments within traces. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture multimodal payloads (images, audio, files) inside my traces
